data.headline: Director & CTO Germany, Austria
data.about:
Sales and technical leader with broad experience and background in x86 based solutions as well as High Performance Computing (HPC), Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Mainframes - leading teams of sales and technical specialists to enable, drive, and support solution sales across Europe including Germany, Switzerland and Austria, focused on outcome and client experience.

Specialties: complex solution sales, change leadership, x86 and datacenter and mainframe market, large scale virtualization, cloud infrastructures, networking, high performance computing, artificial intelligence, financial services, manufacturing, and public sectors

subComponents.title: Director & Chief Technology Officer (CTO) Germany, Austria
subComponents.caption: Jul 2025 - Present · 6 mos

description.text: Build and drive the organizational capability in Germany and Austria to grow solution sales with relevant and deep technical expertise – both for our sales and our channel partners. Elevate the relevance and visibility as Lenovo for C-level and senior decision makers, while transforming expertise into proactive and focused engagements for client success. Shaping our technological go-to-market strategy, guiding long-term account planning, and enabling co-creation with clients and partners. Member of the Lenovo Germany and Austria leadership team.

subComponents.title: Director HPC & AI DACH, France, UKI
subComponents.caption: Apr 2021 - Jun 2025 · 4 yrs 2 mos

description.text:
Accelerate the digital transformation of clients by applying High Performance Computing (HPC) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions for their business outcomes with a distinguished team of highly specialized experts across major markets in Europe.

Profit & loss responsibility for growth in this fast paced technology and solution market including key relationships to some of the largest and most innovative HPC clients in Europe - clients that have embraced the partnership with Lenovo to transform their business and lead the industry to more sustainability without compromising on performance nor reliability. In charge of leading and transforming our team to sustain growth with best in class client experience across diverse markets.

subComponents.title: Platform Leader & Manager, IBM Z & LinuxONE DACH
subComponents.caption: Sep 2014 - Jun 2019 · 4 yrs 9 mos

description.text:
Lead the IBM Z & LinuxONE / Mainframe hardware business for Germany, Austria and Switzerland including platform responsibility for IBM Z.

Help clients accelerate their digital business transformation with the right infrastructure solution providing scale, reliability and security based on the industry's leading platform for transactions & data as well as consolidated and cost efficient workload w/o security compromises to get to market faster.

subComponents.title: Platform Leader System z & Manager Solution Sales, System z New Accounts & New Workloads
subComponents.caption: Jan 2013 - Aug 2014 · 1 yr 7 mos

description.text:
Lead sales growth for the IBM System z / Mainframe platform in Germany with focus on new accounts and new workloads incl. platform management responsibility.

Help clients realize the cost, security and availability benefits for their Cloud, Linux and database workload on the IT industry's leading platform for transaction processing, consolidated and secure data serving, and support for highly available enterprise-wide applications.

subComponents.title: Manager Solution Sales, System z Sales Growth, New Accounts & GB Leader
subComponents.caption: Aug 2012 - Dec 2012 · 4 mos

description.text:
Lead sales growth for the IBM System z / Mainframe platform in Germany with focus on new accounts and new workloads as well as general business clients.

Help clients realize the cost, security and availability benefits for their Cloud, Linux and database workload on the IT industry's leading platform for transaction processing, consolidated and secure data serving, and support for highly available enterprise-wide applications.

subComponents.title: Sales Leader - High Value Servers, Systems x Europe
subComponents.caption: Jan 2012 - Aug 2012 · 7 mos

description.text: Lead the sales for high value x86-based servers (think blades and high end scalable) in Europe. Focus on solution sales and partner enablement as well as the successful introduction of new products. Help clients understand and realize the benefits of Smarter Computing based on IBM System x technology, e.g. for their demanding virtualization, business critical database and application server landscapes.

subComponents.title: Sales Leader - High Value Servers, Systems x NE IOT
subComponents.caption: Jan 2010 - Mar 2012 · 2 yrs 2 mos

description.text: Lead the sales for high value x86-based servers (think blades and high end scalable SMP) in North East Europe with focus on solution and partner enablement as well as the successful introduction of new products. Help clients understand and realize the benefits of dynamic infrastructures based on IBM System x technology, e.g. for their demanding virtualization, database and application server landscape.

subComponents.title: Deep Computing Sales - Financial Services & Insurance
subComponents.caption: Jan 2009 - Jan 2010 · 1 yr

description.text: Drive High Performance Computing (HPC) business with focus on Financial Services and Insurance in Germany - supporting clients with HPC and Deep computing expertise and experience in improving their risk management as well as taking new innovative financial products and services to market quicker and with less risk - to better differentiate vs. competition.

subComponents.title: HPC Clusters Sales Leader, North East Europe
subComponents.caption: Jan 2008 - Dec 2008 · 11 mos

description.text: Lead sales of IBM HPC clusters solutions for North East Europe including sales support for key opportunities, key partner relationships, and sales programs together with worldwide Deep Computing and product development organizations.

Manage and lead the technical pre-sales support for IBM Deep Computing / HPC solutions in Europe - this includes Linux/Microsoft Clusters based on System x, large System p installations, BlueGene and Cell based solutions.

subComponents.title: HPC Lead Architect for Linux Clusters
subComponents.caption: Apr 2001 - Dec 2006 · 5 yrs 8 mos

description.text:
Technical Sales Support for High Performance Computing solutions with focus on Linux clusters.
Guidance and leadership for local field technical sales support colleagues accross Europe.
Influencing business development, sales, and marketing activities for new products and solutions.
